notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q281442_uss_atlanta.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her port side at about 130 m (430 ft) off Lunga Point in Ironbottom Sound: the hull whole, the eight twin 5-inch mounts, the bridge and the two funnels, the superstructure riddled by gunfire, the torpedo hole amidships, masts gone. A war grave (some 170 died, Rear Admiral Norman Scott among them). The damage and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the cruiser as she was in 1942. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
